# code2paper

Transform any local repository or codebase into an academic-grade research paper (Typst / LaTeX / HTML / Markdown + PDF). Built for FOSS devs and vibecoders. Stdlib-only Python CLI.

## Key resources

- GitHub repository: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/code2paper
- Live landing page: https://akashpriyadarshii.github.io/code2paper/
- Documentation (Usage): https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/code2paper/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/code2paper/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Related tool (Understand-Anything): https://github.com/Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything
- Packing engine (Repomix): https://github.com/yamadashy/repomix

## Quick start

```bash
python code2paper.py /path/to/repo
python code2paper.py . --out-dir ./build
```

## Outputs

- `paper.typ` — Typst source (compiles to `paper.pdf` when Typst CLI is installed)
- `paper.tex` — LaTeX source
- `paper.html` — interactive WebPaper (print to PDF from any browser)
- `paper.md` — GitHub-flavored Markdown specification

## Feature summary

- Real AST analysis for Python (functions, classes, imports, cyclomatic complexity); regex heuristics for other languages
- Internal dependency graph from Python imports
- `.gitignore`-aware scanning with binary sniffing and per-file size caps
- Agent skill (`skills/code2paper.md`) for terminal-based LLM agents
